definition: Bounded owned PHB2014 Observant source/API proof: explicit INT/WIS+1 default cap20 and two independent passive5 bonuses through authentic legacy class ASI. Not lip-reading automation, modern Observant completion, generic passive automation, browser acceptance, cloud persistence or publication.
boundaries: Both exact PHB source clauses and the complete genuine modern entry-list hash authenticate against independently pinned digests; no qualifying publisher prose is bundled.

Private exact PHB175 Passive Checks is a separate bounded-proof input, not a230th corpus record/file or a retroactive replacement for the unchanged229 inputs. Official2014 primary review agrees with baseline10+normally applicable check modifiers.
PHB INT/WIS+1 cap20 is one ordered event; cap+0 retains both passive5. Passive bonuses never grant proficiency/expertise, scale with PB or increase active checks.
Manual final Perception override replaces the natural total before the old Perception-only sheet offset. Investigation uses final Investigation check modifiers and never borrows sheetBonuses.passive.

The optional derived Investigation score appears only for structurally authenticated retained known-domain intent, not every character, corrupt/future stores or forged source claims. No new saved total, adjustment target or bridge protocol is created.
Source/automation/level restriction preserves intent; explicit clear/replacement/withdraw removes owned confirmation. Duplicate/stale claims require explicit cleanup, never silent repair.
Genuine XPHB Observant keeps its separate existing skill-choice path but never becomes PHB ability/passive authorization. Unreviewed other-source features remain manual.
Lip-reading, language/visibility conditions, situational passive advantage/disadvantage, Quick Search and other modern effects remain manual or separately unsupported.

Native single/cardbook/linked payload preserve the independent intent. Thin Owlbear exposes totals and Perception only; reimport remains manual and cannot auto-create a grant. Workbench/XLSX passive Investigation interchange is not claimed.

Actual old0478 preserves unknown intent but clear/reselect or base/manual edits can retain stale review, and downgrade loses the new owned source lifecycle. safeEditingCompatibility is false; withdraw/review/reconfirm on a supporting client.

Source/API checks and optional full229 catalog construction do not evaluate18789 corpus rules or alter its denominator. Final full runtime replay, paired locks, exact-head CI and real App browser cases remain separate gates.
